t: Armstrong World Industries - Wikipedia
s: April 2, 2025 - The Whitall Tatum name was phased out, first by removing "Co." from the molds, then replacing the "WT" logo with the Armstrong logo, and finally replacing the molds with ones bearing the Armstrong name. In April 1969, the business was sold to Kerr Glass Manufacturing Corporation. Kerr eventually moved insulator production from Millville to their Dunkirk, Indiana, factory in the mid-1970s, and production ceased by the end of the decade. During World War II, Armstrong made 50-caliber round ammunition, wing tips for airplanes, cork sound insulation for submarines, and camouflage.
